item.name: Comprehensive search and analytics engine for user discovery and analysis

request.name: Comprehensive search and analytics engine for user discovery and analysis

description.content: Powerful search platform that enables advanced user discovery with comprehensive filtering capabilities. Supports complex queries across multiple dimensions including performance metrics, risk profiles, investment patterns, and account characteristics. Ideal for identifying users based on specific trading behaviors and performance criteria.

query.description: (Required) Defines the time period for analyzing user metrics and performance data. Supports various predefined intervals for consistent analysis.
When set to true, filters results to include only test/demo accounts. When false, shows only live accounts. Optional filter.
Filter for users who have explicitly opted in to specific features or programs. Used for compliance and feature-specific filtering.
When true, includes only blocked accounts in the results. Used for compliance and risk management purposes.
Page number for pagination.
Number of results per page.
Sort results by specific field (e.g., -copiers).
Filter for popular investors.
Max gain value filter.
Minimum daily risk score.
Maximum daily risk score.
Minimum monthly risk score.
Maximum monthly risk score.
Minimum weeks since registration.
The registered country ID of the user
The instrument ID (you can also use this to exclude an instrument e.g., -5).
Minimum percentage of investment in the requested instrument ID.
Maximum percentage of investment in the requested instrument ID.

(Required) End date for the analysis period (inclusive) in YYYY-MM-DD format

(Required) Unique identifier of the user whose performance data is being requested
